responsibilities: Designed scalable UI/UX for web and mobile products.
Worked on cryptocurrency platforms and dashboards.
Designed intuitive SMM panel interfaces and workflows.
Contributed to AI powered digital products.
Created user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high fidelity UI.
Collaborated with developers to deliver consistent, production ready designs.
Designed UI/UX for B2B web and mobile products.
Created clean, user friendly interfaces for complex workflows.
Conducted UX research, user flows, and wireframing.
Designed responsive screens and high fidelity prototypes.
Improved usability, consistency, and overall product experience.
Collaborated with developers and product teams from design to delivery.
Transformed business requirements into clear product experiences.
Built engaging landing pages and conversion focused interfaces.
Developed reusable UI components and design systems.
Simplified complex journeys through UX flows and interaction design.
Created responsive experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
Presented design solutions and worked directly with clients and stakeholders.
Designed seamless university application journeys for international students.
Simplified the process of course and university selection.
Created intuitive flows for application and document management.
Designed clear visa processing and application tracking experiences.
Built responsive dashboards for students and application teams.
Improved the overall student journey from application to visa processing.

items.quote: Seam turned a rough idea into a product our users genuinely enjoy. The attention to detail in every screen made the launch feel effortless.
items.name: Swadhin Biswas

items.quote: Working with Seam felt like adding a product strategist to the team, not just a designer. Clear thinking, fast iterations, beautiful results.

items.quote: Every deliverable arrived polished and on time. Seam understands business goals as well as pixels — a rare combination.
items.name: Naimur Rahman
